skill.name: pr-review

security_audit.summary: The static findings for markdown backticks, YAML documentation, BOM handling, and section titles are false positives. No prompt injection or malicious execution intent was found in the reviewed files. One medium semantic issue remains: the validation script prints matched secret text in error output.

remediation.issue: Secret scanner error messages include matched credential text.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the matched value with a fixed placeholder or short hash before printing validation errors.

semantic_findings.title: Secret Values Printed in Validation Output
semantic_findings.description: The validator includes matched secret text in error messages. If run in CI or shared logs, detected credentials could be exposed to reviewers or log storage.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The script captures matched secret text and appends it to an error message. The value is truncated, but credential prefixes or complete short tokens can still leak.

content.value_statement: Skill repository maintainers need consistent reviews for new skill submissions. This skill combines automated structure checks with manual quality criteria for pull requests.
actual_capabilities: Guides reviewers to run validate_skills.py for hard structural checks.
Checks that each skill has SKILL.md with valid frontmatter.
Verifies required name and description fields for skill submissions.
Flags missing recommended license and metadata fields.
Provides manual review criteria for scope, descriptions, scripts, language, and README updates.
Includes secret scanning rules for common API key and bearer token patterns.
limitations: It is tailored to the MiniMax Skills repository layout and policies.
It does not replace a full security review of helper scripts.
Its secret scanning patterns cover only selected high-confidence formats.
Manual quality judgments still depend on reviewer context and repository history.

use_cases.title: Review a New Skill Submission
use_cases.description: Apply hard validation rules and soft quality checks before approving a new community skill.

use_cases.title: Validate Skill Metadata
use_cases.description: Confirm that SKILL.md frontmatter has required fields and follows repository naming rules.

use_cases.title: Prepare Marketplace Quality Feedback
use_cases.description: Turn validation failures and guideline issues into clear pull request review comments.

prompt_templates.title: Basic PR Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small skill pull request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill pull request with the pr-review checklist. Start with hard validation results, then list any quality issues.

prompt_templates.title: Metadata Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review of SKILL.md and repository fields.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this skill submission for required frontmatter, naming consistency, license, metadata, and clear trigger conditions.

prompt_templates.title: Security-Focused Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of a skill that includes scripts or API usage.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill for hardcoded secrets, unsafe script behavior, dependency concerns, and missing environment variable documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Full Maintainer Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a complete maintainer review of this skill PR. Separate blockers, warnings, quality suggestions, and README synchronization issues.

output_examples.input: A new skill PR adds SKILL.md, references, and a helper script.
output: Blockers: missing required description field in SKILL.md.
Warnings: metadata is incomplete and the helper script has no requirements file.
Suggestions: clarify trigger conditions and update the README tables.

output_examples.input: A reviewer asks whether an API skill is ready to merge.
output: Validation passed with no hard blockers.
Review notes: document the required environment variables and avoid realistic example keys.
Merge recommendation: approve after documentation updates are added.

output_examples.input: A maintainer wants concise PR feedback for a skill with overlap concerns.
output: Quality feedback: explain how this skill differs from existing repository skills.
Required follow-up: update README entries before merge.

best_practices: Run automated validation before writing manual review comments.
Separate merge blockers from suggestions so authors can prioritize fixes.
Check README updates whenever a skill is added or renamed.
anti_patterns: Approving a skill when required SKILL.md fields are missing.
Treating warning-level metadata issues as hard blockers without repository policy support.
Ignoring realistic example credentials because they appear in documentation.

faq.question: Does this skill run the validation script automatically?
faq.answer: No. It instructs the agent or reviewer to run the included validation script as the first review step.

faq.question: What does the validation script check?
faq.answer: It checks skill directories, SKILL.md frontmatter, required fields, naming consistency, and selected secret patterns.

faq.question: Are warnings merge blockers?
faq.answer: No. Warnings should be flagged in review, but the skill describes them as non-blocking suggestions.

faq.question: Can it review general software pull requests?
faq.answer: It is designed for MiniMax Skills repository submissions, not broad application code review.

faq.question: Does it detect every possible secret?
faq.answer: No. The included scanner covers selected high-confidence patterns and relies on manual review for other credential forms.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
